Topic: AI design and interfaces

Posted by KP (@thisiskp_) on 2026-10-15

I use Instinct every day, and its interactive answers have spoiled me. 

Going back to a wall of text in every other AI app feels painful..

OpenUI lets any agent answer with real interfaces, and it isn't tied to a specific model or component library. 

Your components, any model

For 30 years, technology has moved in one direction: turning information into intuitive interfaces

Somehow, the smartest software we’ve ever built took us back to a textbox

We’ve spent the last 2 years at @openuidev trying to fix that. 6 months ago we open-sourced it: 10K+
